caption: The video captures a static top-down view into a transparent blender jar, its side handles and grey backdrop fixed while a thick pink-purple smoothie churns in a swirling central vortex. Strawberry halves and dark blueberries fall into the opening above the mixture, tumbling and drifting gradually. One strawberry half near the lower vortex rotates steadily upward, moving toward the center. A cut strawberry at the bottom-left shifts and edges toward the center, while sliced pieces slide in from the lower-right to crowd the foreground. The blueberries near the bottom shift inward, and another dark berry surfaces at the lower-right corner partway through. The vortex reshapes subtly with each frame, consistent with a running blender, yet splatter specks on the inner walls stay unmoved. No fruit piece vanishes or finishes blending within this excerpt, leaving the addition suspended mid-process.
